name: PSG Corporation Public Company Limited
summary: PSG Corporation Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiary, engages in turnkey engineering procurement construction (EPC) and large-scale construction projects in Thailand and the Lao People's Democratic Republic. The company offers construction services for projects, such as civil engineering, industrial construction, superstructure, installation, and mechanical and electrical engineering projects, as well as roads, infrastructure, and other projects.
